title_zh: EditStream：用于交互式视频生成与编辑的统一自回归框架
title_en: EditStream: A Unified Autoregressive Framework for Interactive Video Generation and Editing
summary_zh: EditStream引入了一种基于DiT模型的统一框架，用于交互式视频生成和编辑，通过灵活的任务特定条件控制，多任务支持包括文本到视频、图像到视频、视频到视频、编辑传播、参考引导编辑及相机姿态变化等。该框架通过两阶段蒸馏方法（速度矩匹配与自回归展开）提高生成速度和质量，解决了少步自回归视频生成中的过饱和、运动退化和时间不稳定等问题。EditStream为高质量扩散视频模型与交互式创作流程提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案。
summary_en: EditStream introduces a unified DiT-based framework for interactive video generation and editing, supporting multiple tasks such as Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, Video-to-Video, Editing Propagation, Reference-guided Editing, and Camera Pose Change through task-specific conditioning. Utilizing a two-stage distillation approach combining Velocity Moment Matching and autoregressive unrolling, it achieves fast, few-step autoregressive generation that addresses common issues like oversaturation, motion degradation, and temporal instability. EditStream offers a practical, scalable solution bridging high-quality diffusion-based video models with interactive creative workflows.

title_zh: KVBoost：基于偏差引导的重计算的块级键值缓存重用，用于高效大语言模型推理
title_en: KVBoost: Chunk-Level Key-Value Cache Reuse with Deviation-Guided Recomputation for Efficient Large Language Model Inference
summary_zh: KVBoost 是一个针对 HuggingFace 兼容的解码器模型设计的块级键值缓存重用系统，支持无论内容位置的缓存重用。它通过双哈希键方案将位置身份与内容身份分离，支持精确与近似缓存匹配。为解决因独立缓存块带来的注意力边界误差，KVBoost 提出选择性重计算和缓存混合重计算两种修复策略。系统还采用了非对称量化、自适应块边界拆分和带权重的缓存逐出策略。在 Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B 模型上，KVBoost 将首字节时间减少了4.49倍，相比前缀缓存提升16%，且推理准确率几乎无损。KVBoost 是一种实用且内存受限的推理加速方法，兼容 RoPE 基础架构且无需改动模型架构。
summary_en: KVBoost is a chunk-level key-value cache reuse system designed for HuggingFace-compatible decoder models that enables reuse regardless of content position by employing a dual-hash keying scheme separating positional and content identities. It addresses attention boundary errors using SelectiveRecompute and CacheBlendRecompute repair strategies and incorporates asymmetric quantization, adaptive chunk splitting, and importance-weighted eviction under fixed memory budgets. Tested on Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B, KVBoost achieves a 4.49x reduction in time-to-first-token and outperforms prefix caching by 16% without accuracy loss. It offers a practical, memory-bounded inference acceleration layer compatible with RoPE-based models without architectural modification.

title_zh: AIREP：AI运行时治理中的每决策证据协议
title_en: AIREP: A Protocol for Per-Decision Evidence in AI Runtime Governance
summary_zh: 这篇arXiv论文介绍了AIREP协议，该协议用于记录自动化AI运行时的治理决策。当AI运行时对单个输出执行发布、阻止、延期、编辑或升级时，AIREP会将该决策作为一个独立签名对象记录，任何方均可离线检查，而无需依赖生成该结果的运行时环境。每条记录采用SHA-256哈希链绑定，确保不可篡改且能检测缺失。协议定义了一组有限的动词及政策依据，并通过引用哈希保证输入、输出和证据的完整性。此外，方案设计中采用命名空间限制厂商、模型和领域特定内容，并通过机械中立性测试保证格式的共享中立性。论文还介绍了参考实现和多语言一致性测试套件，讨论了多运行时链条、同步及新鲜度证据等挑战，旨在推动AI运行时治理记录格式的统一与采用。
summary_en: This arXiv paper presents AIREP, a protocol designed to record governance decisions made by automated AI runtimes. When a runtime releases, blocks, defers, redacts, or escalates an output, AIREP records this decision as a single signed object verifiable offline independently of the runtime. Records include a closed set of decision verbs under a stated policy, reference inputs, outputs, and evidence by hash rather than full data, and specify the scope of evidence coverage. Records link via a SHA-256 hash chain ensuring tamper detection and continuity. Vendor-, model-, and domain-specific content is isolated to a single optional namespace while mechanical neutrality tests maintain format neutrality. The paper describes a reference implementation and a bilingual conformance kit, discusses implementation challenges like canonical form alignment, freshness witnesses, and multi-runtime chains, offering the format for adoption by AI runtimes recording governance decisions.
why_it_matters_zh: 该论文提供了一个创新且具体的协议框架，用于AI系统关键的治理决策记录，保障决策透明性、可验证性和防篡改性，是AI伦理与安全治理技术的重要发展，具有实际应用价值。
why_it_matters_en: The paper proposes a concrete, innovative protocol framework for recording governance decisions in AI systems, ensuring transparency, verifiability, and tamper resistance of such decisions. This represents a significant advancement in AI ethics and runtime safety governance technology with practical applicability.
